newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Four people die, 52 injured in Tunisia road crash.
newsitem.headline: Four people die, 52 injured in Tunisia road crash.

text.p: Four people died and 52 were injured in a collision between a bus and a truck in Tunisia, newspapers reported on Friday.
They said the crash occurred on Thursday on the Raouad road, in northern Tunis.
A few hours after the crash, newly appointed Interior Minister Mohamed Ben Rejeb called his staff for a meeting to recommend increasing highway police patrols.
